title: Set Home page Total P&L span to static 17.5

requirements.summary: Change the Home page Total P&L value span to render the exact static text "17.5" with no currency symbol or numeric formatting, without altering any surrounding elements.
acceptanceCriteria: When navigating to the Home page, the Total P&L card’s value span renders exactly: 17.5
The displayed value is not derived from metrics, does not use numeric formatting (e.g., toFixed), and does not include a currency symbol
Only the selected span element is modified; surrounding layout/structure and other metric cards remain unchanged

file_operations.description: Update only the existing Total P&L value <span> (the one currently rendering "$...toFixed(2)") so its children are exactly the static text "17.5" (remove "$", remove metrics usage, remove toFixed/fallbacks) while keeping the element as a <span> and leaving all surrounding JSX/layout unchanged.
